title: No shelter holds the false self
summary: False shelters collapse, but love of the Lord still holds. Receive the nearness already holding you.
takeaway: Receive the nearness already holding you.
lifeApplication: At the next quiet ache, place a hand on the chest and name the companionship being offered before the mind says alone.

source.shortMeaning: False shelters collapse, but love of the Lord still holds.
source.lifeApplication: When you reach for a quick shelter, ask whether it can actually hold you.

evidence.coreClaim: False shelters collapse, but love of the Lord still holds.
evidence.turn: Without the Beloved and the Shabad, surface beauty stays false.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the next quiet ache, place a hand on the chest and name the companionship being offered before the mind says alone.
